batch_note: All tools below can be combined and executed in a single batch pass. Upload an entire directory tree, select multiple operations simultaneously, and receive all processed files in a structured ZIP with the original folder hierarchy preserved.

skills.name: ma-cleanroom-document-sanitization
skills.description: Comprehensive document preparation for M&A Cleanrooms and Virtual Data Rooms (VDR). Strips metadata, redacts PII, flattens PDF layers, and generates SHA-256 audit manifests.

skills.name: sanitize-metadata
skills.description: Permanently remove hidden metadata: author name, creation/modification dates, software fingerprints, GPS coordinates, revision history, and EXIF data. Supports: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, PNG, JPG, JPEG, PPTX.

skills.name: redact-pdf
skills.description: Permanently black out (redact) sensitive text, names, IDs, addresses, and financial data from PDF pages. Irreversible pixel-level removal.

skills.name: convert-to-pdf-online
skills.description: Batch-convert Word (DOCX/DOC), Excel (XLSX/XLS/XLSM), PowerPoint (PPTX/PPT), TXT, and Images to PDF in a single pass. Folder structure preserved.

skills.name: remove-pdf-signatures
skills.description: Strip digital signatures, certified locks, approval locks, and editing restrictions from PDF files. Restores editability.

skills.name: rebuild-repair-pdf
skills.description: Fix corrupted or broken PDF file structures with built-in OCR engine for scanned PDF documents.

skills.name: add-watermark-pdf
skills.description: Stamp custom diagonal text watermarks ('CONFIDENTIAL', 'M&A DUE DILIGENCE') on PDF pages in batch.

skills.name: encrypt-pdf
skills.description: Password-protect PDFs with 256-bit AES encryption and set permission restrictions for copying, editing, or printing.

skills.name: flatten-pdf-to-image
skills.description: Convert PDF pages into raster image PDFs. Removes text layers, form fields, and hidden vector layers.

skills.name: pdf-bundle-summary
skills.description: Generate professional dossier summary reports (borderou/reestr) in Excel, PDF, and CSV for folders of documents.

skills.name: advanced-bundle-report
skills.description: Generate deep audit reports in Excel format with document numbers, titles, formats, file sizes, SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, protection status, and page totals.

skills.name: convert-to-pdfa-online
skills.description: Convert standard PDFs to ISO 19005 compliant PDF/A-1b, PDF/A-2b, or PDF/A-3b archival format for long-term legal and judicial compliance. PDF only.
